T: Toys in the box. Snacks on the bench.
D: A cowboy doll is threatened when a flashy space ranger toy arrives on his kid's birthday.
P: Serve the pizza when Woody and Buzz hitch a ride on the Pizza Planet truck.
S: Mr Potato Head loaded potato bites
Smashed baby potatoes with cheddar, bacon, sour cream and chives
Crispy baby potatoes smashed and loaded with sour cream, bacon, cheese and chives. Boil 1kg baby potatoes until tender, smash flat on an oiled tray and roast at 220C for 25 minutes.
Dough tied and baked golden, parsley butter and parmesan, marinara for dipping

Pizza dough tied into knots, baked golden and tossed in garlic parsley butter and parmesan, with warm marinara for dunking. Cut 500g pizza dough into 12 pieces, roll each into a rope and tie into a knot. Place on a lined tray and bake at 220C for 12 to 14 minutes until golden. Melt 60g butter with 3 crushed garlic cloves and chopped parsley and toss the hot knots in it with 30g grated parmesan. Simmer 300g passata with garlic, oregano and salt for 10 minutes for dipping.
Army men pea and edamame salad
Peas and edamame tossed with mint, lemon and olive oil, served in little buckets
Fresh peas and edamame blanched, tossed with mint, lemon, olive oil and flaky salt, served in little toy buckets.
M: Thin crust pepperoni and mozzarella pizza with black olive craters
Pizza dough stretched round, crushed tomato, mozzarella and pepperoni rounds arranged like planets, olive slice craters, baked on a hot steel.
Moving day grilled cheese and tomato soup
Cheesy sourdough toasties, roast tomato soup for dunking

Golden sourdough toasties oozing cheddar and mozzarella, dunked into roast tomato soup topped with basil, cream and crunchy croutons. Roast 1kg tomatoes, 1 onion and 3 garlic cloves with oil at 200C for 35 minutes. Blend with 500ml chicken stock and 1 tsp sugar, then heat with 60ml cream. Butter the outsides of 8 slices sourdough and fill with 200g grated cheddar and 100g grated mozzarella. Cook in a pan over medium-low heat for 4 minutes a side. Cut into soldiers and serve with the soup and basil.
W: Chocolate layer cake with chocolate buttercream and a fondant cowboy hat
Chocolate cake baked at 175C, chocolate buttercream, a fondant cowboy hat on top, candles in.
K: Pineapple, lemonade and lime punch with green grape aliens on sticks
Pineapple juice and lemonade tinted green, with grapes on sticks for little aliens.

steps.text: Boil the potatoes until tender and drain.

Grate the cheddar. Dice the smoked tofu small and fry in the rest of the oil with the paprika until crisp.
Top with cheese and the crisp tofu and return to the oven.
Add sour cream and chopped chives.

s.n: Mr Potato Head loaded potato bites
s.note: Smashed baby potatoes with cheddar, bacon, sour cream and chives
s.how: Boil 1kg baby potatoes until tender, smash flat on an oiled tray and roast at 220C for 25 minutes. Top with 100g grated cheddar and 3 rashers crispy chopped bacon, return for 3 minutes, then add 150g sour cream and chives.

s.n: Army men pea and edamame salad
s.note: Peas and edamame tossed with mint, lemon and olive oil, served in little buckets
s.how: Blanch 200g peas and 200g edamame for 2 minutes and drain. Toss with chopped mint, lemon zest and juice, 2 tbsp olive oil and flaky salt. Spoon into little toy buckets or cups.

m.note: Thin crust pepperoni and mozzarella pizza with black olive craters
m.how: Stretch 2 balls pizza dough (500g total) into rounds. Spread with 200g crushed tomatoes, cover with 250g grated mozzarella, then arrange pepperoni rounds like planets and black olive slices like craters. Bake on the hottest tray at 250C for 10 minutes until blistered.

w.note: Chocolate layer cake with chocolate buttercream and a fondant cowboy hat
w.how: Beat 200g butter and 250g sugar, add 4 eggs, then fold in 250g self-raising flour, 50g cocoa and 200ml milk. Bake in two tins at 175C for 30 minutes. Cover in 200g butter beaten with 350g icing sugar and 40g cocoa. Top with a fondant cowboy hat and candles.

d.note: Pineapple, lemonade and lime punch with green grape aliens on sticks
d.how: Mix 1L pineapple juice with 500ml lemonade, the juice of 2 limes and a few drops of green food colouring in a jug. Add ice and a handful of green grapes on sticks as aliens, and pour into cups.
